def choose_move(observation):
    x, y = observation.get('self_position', (0,0))
    width = observation.get('grid_width', 0)
    height = observation.get('grid_height', 0)
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    obstacles = set(observation.get('obstacles', []))
    opponent_pos = observation.get('opponent_position')
    score_diff = observation.get('scores', [0,0])
    my_score = score_diff[0]
    opp_score = score_diff[1]
    path = observation.get('self_path', [])
    opp_path = observation.get('opponent_path', [])
    # Move towards closest resource if available
    if resources:
        target = min(resources, key=lambda p: abs(p[0]-x)+abs(p[1]-y))
        dx = (target[0] > x) - (target[0] < x)
        dy = (target[1] > y) - (target[1] < y)
        if 0 <= x+dx < width and 0 <= y+dy < height and (x+dx, y+dy) not in obstacles:
            return [dx, dy]
    # Else, try to move away from opponent if opponent exists
    if opponent_pos:
        ox, oy = opponent_pos
        dx = (x - ox)
        dy = (y - oy)
        if dx != 0:
            dx = dx // abs(dx)
        if dy != 0:
            dy = dy // abs(dy)
        # Try to move away, fallback to neutral move
        for move in [[dx, 0], [0, dy], [dx, dy], [0,0]]:
            nx, ny = x+move[0], y+move[1]
            if 0 <= nx < width and 0 <= ny < height and (nx, ny) not in obstacles:
                return move
    # Default move: stay in place
    return [0, 0]
